data.summary: If you have a WhatsApp Business account, you can connect it to communicate with your contacts.
data.description:
WhatsApp is the world's most popular messaging app.

Its integration with the VTEX CX Platform allows you to connect your business phone number to the app and create automated flows to assist your customers.

You can use this integration on the VTEX CX Platform without having the business manager verified and start up to 50 business-started conversations with different numbers within 24 hours. Even without the business manager verified, you can have up to two numbers in WABA.

The first 1,000 conversations each month are free, allowing you to create great customer experiences before paying for them. Each WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) will receive 1,000 free conversations per month, which can be started by the business (if you don't have a verified manager, note the 50-conversation limit per number) or by the user. This benefit is provided at the WABA level. Therefore, even if the account has several attached numbers, the free conversation limit remains 1,000. The free conversation limit is restored monthly according to the WABA's associated time zone.

Also, with VTEX CX Platform's free plan, you can communicate with 200 active contacts (unique contacts within a 1-month period).

By verifying the business manager, you can further increase your integration potential with WhatsApp, for example, by increasing the tier of business-started conversations (1,000; 10,000; 100,000; or unlimited), with the option to acquire OBA (official account badge/green ticket) and have more than two numbers per WABA.

This version of the WhatsApp API through the VTEX CX Platform supports customizations such as photos, videos, file sharing, descriptions, and template messages (conversations can be started by the user or the business).

configuration_guide.FC:
You can connect a FreshChat account to automate sending and receiving messages via FreshChat. This will also support Apple Business Chat if configured in your FreshChat account.

Each message sent to the channel will have a URN in the format channel-uuid/user-uuid where the channel UUID is the FreshChat channel UUID.

  1. In the FreshChat web interface, under Settings, API Tokens, select Generate token. Once created, enter it below.
  2. Under Settings, select Webhooks, copy the public key, and paste it below. This ensures that all FreshChat webhook requests are authenticated.
  3. Finally, you'll need the agent UUID that VTEX CX Platform will use when it sends FreshChat messages. This is available via the FreshChat API.
  4. Once you've configured all the details and clicked Submit, the confirmation page will show the URL to use for FreshChat Webhooks. Enter this URL on the Settings page under Webhooks, where you copied the public key.
configuration_guide.IB:
You can connect your Infobip number by entering your number, username, and password here.

Once connected, we will provide URLs to endpoints so Infobip can call when it wants to send a message to RapidPro.
configuration_guide.JC:

data.description:
If you have a CRM in Omie, you can integrate it with VTEX CX Platform and automate actions in your CRM through your chatbot.

By integrating VTEX CX Platform with your Omie CRM, you'll be able to perform actions such as:

- Include opportunities in the CRM
- Search invoices and entries
- List customers

In the Integrations module, perform the integration with Omie by providing the API Key and API Secret data.
After that, go to the Flows module and create a flow. There, you'll have an available card called External Services, where you can perform all the actions mentioned here with Omie CRM.

data.summary: Powerful integration: VTEX CX Platform + ChatGPT. Automated service with a human touch, instant answers, and a custom experience. Try it now!

We present a powerful synergy between VTEX CX Platform and ChatGPT, a perfect combination to transform your customer interactions into an unparalleled experience!

With the VTEX CX Platform integration with ChatGPT, you have an intelligent virtual assistant powered by OpenAI's advanced natural language technology. Imagine fully automated customer service, but with a personalized human touch.

VTEX CX Platform, which offers an intuitive interface and versatile features, becomes even more efficient with ChatGPT. It delivers quick, precise responses to address your customers' questions and needs, anytime, anywhere.

ChatGPT understands the nuances of human language, continuously learning and adapting. It not only offers quick and efficient answers but also maintains natural and relevant conversations, establishing a genuine connection with your customers.

Take advantage of this integration to improve customer support, automate repetitive tasks, and provide a personalized and pleasant experience. ChatGPT, powered by VTEX CX Platform, helps increase efficiency, save time, and achieve exceptional customer satisfaction.

Try the integration between VTEX CX Platform and ChatGPT now to offer intelligent, dynamic, and fully tailored service to your business needs. Join this revolution in customer interaction and watch your results reach new heights!

Now you can easily connect the product catalog, enabling for direct sales via WhatsApp. This innovative solution offers an instant, agile, and personalized sales experience, helping you boost your sales.

Main features:

Easy integration with VTEX:
- Connect the VTEX product catalog to VTEX CX Platform simply and automatically synchronize your products.
- Quick updates ensure your store is always aligned with the latest inventory and price changes.

Direct sales via WhatsApp:
- Turn conversations into transactions, allowing customers to browse, select, and purchase products directly via WhatsApp.
- Increase convenience by reaching customers where they are already active.

Additional benefits:

Global scale:
- Reach a global audience through WhatsApp, expanding your international sales opportunities.

Simple setup:
- Fast setup without the need for advanced technical knowledge.

Specialized technical support:
- Dedicated support to ensure smooth implementation and fast issue resolution.

Try it now and discover how to efficiently boost your sales!

channels.VP: Connect to a Viber public channel to send and receive messages to Viber users for free. Your users will need an Android, Windows, or iOS device and a Viber account to send and receive messages.
channels.WC: Add a WeChat bot to send and receive messages to WeChat users for free. Your users will need an Android, Windows, or iOS device and a WeChat account to send and receive messages.
channels.ZVS: If you have an SMS number from Zenvia, you can connect it to communicate with your contacts.
channels.ZVW: If you have a WhatsApp number from Zenvia, you can connect it to communicate with your contacts via WhatsApp.
